meaning: 'verified' means an independent reader attested every item against the source. It does not upgrade any compliance claim, and the script cannot prove the reader's independence - it records the attestation.

verifier.statement: Second independent reader. 1,644 attestations are carried unchanged from the first independent reader; they cover content that is byte-identical between the artifact that reader attested and this corrected rebuild. I freshly attested only the 19 corrected items against the corrected artifact (out3 HTML, sha256 730a4f56...dca7f, verified against the worksheet binding): I read the source PDF directly via pdfjs per-item geometry with resolved PostScript font names on pages 40, 87, 118 and 119, reconstructed the three-column List of Tax Topics from coordinates, compared every topic-table cell source-vs-plan-vs-HTML, and checked italic/roman run boundaries for the three inline-style items. All 19 verified; no new discrepancies.
